notes.title: Patch Beta 0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Additions
[/h1][p]1. Added the last quests of the main storyline[/p][p]2. Added a log showing rare items/money/xp/skills/esteem received in the lower left corner of the screen[/p][p]3. Added an "Immunity" system, some enemies are immune to certain types of elements[/p][p]4. Added a hidden item system that will be displayed if you have an item compass equipped[/p][p]5. Added new weapons[/p][p]6. Added new skills[/p][p]7. Added a new weapon type "Staff"[/p][p]8. Added a sprite of Laisa using a staff[/p][p]9. Added breakable items in Dreadfort[/p][p]10. Added breakable item "Void Metal"[/p][p]11. Added a new tutorial "Hidden Item"[/p][p]12. Added a crafting system for items in anvils scattered around the map[/p][p]13. Added a special mechanic for an enemy[/p][p]14. Added new attacks[/p][p]15. Added new "Elements"[/p][p]16. Added a new quest to search for a hidden item after talking with Alice before going to Duskwood[/p][p]17. Added icons for trait attacks (Esteem/Mastery/Wisdom/Courage/Determination)[/p][p]18. Added new end-game credits screen[/p][p]19. Added Impact frames on enemies and breakable items[/p][h1]
Changes
[/h1][p]1. Changed Grimdur's location after the Memory Game quest[/p][p]2. Changed some lighting[/p][p]3. Changed combat tutorial to include "Immunity"[/p][p]4. Temporarily changed Chests to "Shiny" items while we try to fix an issue with chests[/p][h1]
Fixes
[/h1][p]1. Fixed enemy not attacking[/p][p]2. Fixed certain enemies not showing an image in the hud[/p][p]3. Fixed certain enemies not doing damage[/p][p]4. Fixed crystal shard sprites[/p][p]5. Fixed some breakable item sprites[/p][p]6. Fixed Esteem going into the negative[/p][p]7. Fixed Esteem rising above max on certain items Occasions[/p][p]8. Fixed Enemies not appearing when starting combat[/p][p]9. Fixed bug where Laisa's head was "cut off" by the vendors in Largefield[/p][p]10. Fixed current map not appearing correctly in save[/p][p]11. Fixed sound options not working in main menu[/p][p]12. Fixed Lava not appearing in Strongarm cave[/p][p]13. Fixed enemies sometimes attacking after dying[/p][p]14. Fixed "Always Run" not working properly[/p][p]15. Fixed volume options in in-game options[/p][p]16. Fixed certain sidequests being able to be abused to get infinite items[/p][p]17. Fixed sidequests not deleting items correctly from inventory[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1.3
notes.content:
[olist]
[b][*] Fixed breakable items being impossible to break if you tried to interact with them before equipping the tool
[*] Fixed Alice's quest to get 3 silver ores where if you saved the game the ore disappeared
[*] Fixed issue with enemy encounters where you would encounter infinite enemies[/b]
[/olist]
